status: Inventory obligations; no workflow acceptance claimed

A01.requirement: Fresh boot, no existing data, stable initial screen/grid, reload
A01.observable_oracle: Ready state, frame/LED layout, no Lua errors, capability inventory

A02.requirement: Grid coordinates, levels 0–15, multiple held keys, press/release and reconnect
A02.observable_oracle: Runtime key trace and raw LED matrix; no stuck held input

A03.requirement: Three keys/encoders, shift combinations, param menus, confirm/cancel, file/text dialogs
A03.observable_oracle: Callback order, screen state and resulting public behaviour

A04.requirement: Create/edit trigs, note and velocity pages, remove trigs, page cycling
A04.observable_oracle: Grid cells and exact note/velocity event table before/after edit

A05.requirement: Channels, device/channel selection, pattern assignment, merge modes, mute, length and wrap
A05.observable_oracle: MIDI port/channel, merged event tables, mute silence, independent channel lengths

A06.requirement: Scale, root, degree, rotation, transposition, octave, masks and chords; quantiser options
A06.observable_oracle: Independently computed small pitch tables and chord note sets

A07.requirement: Start/stop, reset options, clock divisions, tempo changes, swing/shuffle
A07.observable_oracle: Note/transport ordering, beat-domain phase and wall-clock bounds

A08.requirement: Probability and random pitch/trig options with fixed seeds and boundary probabilities
A08.observable_oracle: Repeatable trace, 0/100% boundaries, pitch membership; avoid flaky statistical gates

A09.requirement: Trig locks, trigless locks, slides and wrap options, scale/transposition/octave locks
A09.observable_oracle: Notes/CCs/values at defined steps and boundary transitions

A10.requirement: Strum, arpeggio, acceleration, spread, chord shape/velocity/mute-root options
A10.observable_oracle: Ordered note-on/off tables, positive durations, documented overlap behaviour

A11.requirement: Song slot operations, repeats, sequence length, transitions, song mode/reset choices
A11.observable_oracle: Pattern sequence and boundary events; no missing/double transition

A12.requirement: Live MIDI recording, held-step entry, chords, quantised starts/lengths, record arm/disarm
A12.observable_oracle: Replay captured input as expected output; grid/screen shows edit

A13.requirement: MIDI controller mapping, relative binary-offset encoders, ranges/channels/selected-channel mapping
A13.observable_oracle: Intended value changes only; wrong port/channel does not alter target

A14.requirement: Device configuration discovery and malformed config handling; CC/program changes including Elektron and Sinfonion software output
A14.observable_oracle: Expected MIDI bytes/order; invalid config diagnostic and absence from selectable devices

A15.requirement: Undo/redo and memory operations, change cancellation
A15.observable_oracle: Previous and reapplied project behaviour through output and display

A16.observable_oracle: Round-trip MIDI trace and visible edits; original files preserved on failure

A17.requirement: Matrix/toolkit LFOs/modulation and parameter mapping interactions
A17.observable_oracle: Both mod paths change actual Mosaic MIDI-device parameters with known shape/range/rate and emitted MIDI effects

A18.requirement: MIDI panic, pending note cancellation, repeated stop/start and disconnected client
A18.observable_oracle: No outstanding notes after defined drain, no duplicate active clocks

A19.requirement: Dirty display/grid refresh, page indicators, tooltips, edits during playback
A19.observable_oracle: Rendered state updates; seeded stale-frame defect is detected

A20.requirement: LLM reproduce/edit/reload/verify loop on a candidate Mosaic change
A20.observable_oracle: Saved input recipe, failing baseline, passing candidate, unaffected regressions

A21.requirement: Error observability: Lua exceptions including coroutine errors, backend death, API failure
A21.observable_oracle: Nonzero runner exit and structured diagnostic artifacts, never timeout-as-pass

A22.requirement: Real-time mixed-feature endurance and clock/MIDI ordering
A22.observable_oracle: Bounded timing, no lost events, no stuck inputs/notes or leaked sessions

A23.requirement: Automated clean install and execution on declared WSL profile
A23.observable_oracle: Inventory complete, browser + runtime checks, host facts identify WSL

A24.requirement: Native Linux portability on declared profile
A24.observable_oracle: Same suite and fixtures, host facts identify native Linux
